data.name: Thresholds.Subtitle
data.value: The thresholds that change the rules for this company: VAT exemption and VAT scheme, company size category, subcontractor vigilance certificate, fees to report. Lettra shows where each one stands, whether it will be crossed before the end of the period and what changes then.

data.name: Thresholds.Method
data.value: Projection: the period's running total, extended to its last day at the pace of the last {0} days. A threshold is "near" when it is crossed or will be within {1} months.

data.name: Thresholds.Stat.Crossed.Hint
data.value: The rules change or have changed

data.name: Thresholds.Stat.Projected.Hint
data.value: At the current pace, before the end of the period

data.name: Thresholds.ProfileMissing
data.value: Without a company profile, Lettra cannot read the VAT thresholds or the company size category: only suppliers and fee beneficiaries are watched.

data.name: Thresholds.Empty.Text
data.value: VAT and size thresholds are read from the company profile; suppliers and fee beneficiaries only appear when they get close to their threshold.

data.name: Thresholds.Code.tva.franchise.ventes.base
data.value: VAT exemption, sales of goods: base threshold

data.name: Thresholds.Code.tva.franchise.ventes.majore
data.value: VAT exemption, sales of goods: upper threshold

data.name: Thresholds.Code.tva.regime-simplifie.ventes.majore
data.value: Simplified scheme, sales of goods: upper threshold

data.name: Thresholds.Change.tva.franchise.ventes.base
data.value: Above the base threshold over the year, the exemption ends on the following 1 January: invoices then carry VAT and VAT returns start.

data.name: Thresholds.Change.tva.franchise.ventes.majore
data.value: Above the upper threshold, the exemption ends with the invoice that crosses it: that invoice and the following ones carry VAT. Tell the accounting firm.

data.name: Thresholds.Change.tva.franchise.services.base
data.value: Above the base threshold over the year, the exemption ends on the following 1 January: invoices then carry VAT and VAT returns start.

data.name: Thresholds.Change.tva.franchise.services.majore
data.value: Above the upper threshold, the exemption ends with the invoice that crosses it: that invoice and the following ones carry VAT. Tell the accounting firm.

data.name: Thresholds.Change.tva.regime-simplifie.ventes.majore
data.value: Above the upper threshold, the standard scheme applies from the start of the year: monthly VAT returns (CA3) instead of the annual return. Tell the accounting firm.

data.name: Thresholds.Change.tva.regime-simplifie.services.majore
data.value: Above the upper threshold, the standard scheme applies from the start of the year: monthly VAT returns (CA3) instead of the annual return. Tell the accounting firm.

data.name: Thresholds.Change.tva.trimestrielle.base
data.value: Above the threshold over the year, VAT returns become monthly from the following 1 January.

data.name: Thresholds.Change.tva.trimestrielle.majore
data.value: Above the upper threshold, VAT returns become monthly from the month it is crossed.

data.name: Thresholds.Change.taille.micro
data.value: Above this turnover, the company may change category: headcount and balance sheet total count too. Check with the accounting firm; the category notably sets the e-invoicing timetable.

data.name: Thresholds.Change.taille.pme
data.value: Above this turnover, the company may change category: headcount and balance sheet total count too. Check with the accounting firm; the category notably sets the e-invoicing timetable.

data.name: Thresholds.Change.taille.eti
data.value: Above this turnover, the company may change category: headcount and balance sheet total count too. Check with the accounting firm; the category notably sets the e-invoicing timetable.

data.name: Thresholds.Change.vigilance.sous-traitant
data.value: From this amount, ask this supplier for its URSSAF vigilance certificate, then every six months while the work lasts: without it, the company can be held jointly liable for its social contributions.

data.name: Thresholds.Change.das2.beneficiaire
data.value: Above the threshold, the amounts paid to this beneficiary during the financial year are reported with the tax return (DAS 2).

data.name: Thresholds.Projection
data.value: Projection at the end of the period: {0}

data.name: Thresholds.Disclaimer
data.value: An early warning, computed without AI from validated invoices: the turnover counted is the amount invoiced excluding VAT (without disbursements and down payments), without acquisitions. The accounting firm confirms any tax consequence before you act.
